input.title: Data Analyst Intern
input.descriptionText:
Harbor Capital Partners is a mid-market private equity firm. Our portfolio analytics group is hiring a Summer Data Analyst Intern.

In this role you will build Tableau dashboards tracking portfolio company KPIs, pull data with SQL, and prepare analyses in Excel for investment committee memos.

Requirements
• Advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups)
• SQL
• Tableau or a similar BI tool
• Excellent written and verbal communication

Preferred
• Python (pandas)
• Familiarity with financial modeling or accounting concepts

We look for analysts who are detail-oriented, intellectually honest, and comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders.

gold.summary: Private equity data analyst internship building Tableau KPI dashboards with SQL and Excel.
